accepts.because: one finished turn to say in the chat it came from; context.chat_id picks the chat, and without it the connector has no address

emits.because: somebody wrote in the chat -- one user-origin turn, with the chat and the sender identity on the hop, for whatever screens or receives turns
the connector itself failed -- it could not read an inbound message or could not deliver an outbound one. Drain it: undrained, a chat that never got its answer looks like an agent that never answered

required_drains.because: a reply this connector could not deliver leaves on the error lane and nowhere else. Undrained, the one failure a chat surface has -- the answer that never arrived -- is invisible at exactly the end where somebody is waiting for it

description.purpose: Scope marker of one chat connector: the credential-bearing proxy cell behind a sealed boundary. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS -- params.ports is empty, so no edge reaches the proxy and a caller names the hive plus a lane on hop.route.
description.use_when: One per bot token. Instantiate with add_nodes and wire in_reply in / turn + error out at the HIVE path, in the same mutation.
description.not_in_scope: No sender filter, no bot commands, no history, no persona.
description.contract_in: in_reply -- the finished assistant turn, with the chat in context.chat_id.
description.contract_out: turn -- one inbound chat message as a user turn. error -- the connector's own failure, which the parent MUST drain.
